title: The world’s first fossil-free steel ready for delivery
lineage: Producer’s contemporaneous report of rolling and trial delivery. It identifies the source of the iron without requiring acceptance of global priority.

passages.quote: In July, SSAB Oxelösund rolled the first steel produced using HYBRIT technology
passages.note: Evidence for July rolling at Oxelösund and reported trial delivery to Volvo Group by the release.

passages.locator: Paragraph starting SSAB, LKAB and Vattenfall created HYBRIT
passages.quote: This first sponge iron has since been used
passages.note: Explicitly ties the rolled HYBRIT steel to the hydrogen-reduced batch from Luleå.
